REQ-UI-001.heading: Button
REQ-UI-001.description: A button starts one action. It responds the same way to a mouse and a keyboard, and it tells everyone, including screen reader users, when it cannot be used.
REQ-UI-001.rule: A button responds the same way to a mouse and a keyboard
REQ-UI-001.scenario: A keyboard user activates a button with Enter and then Space
steps: Given the Button playground is open
Then the button named "Start rip" is accessible by role and name
When I press Tab
Then the button named "Start rip" has focus
And the button named "Start rip" has not been activated
When I press Enter
Then the button named "Start rip" has been activated 1 time
When I press Space
Then the button named "Start rip" has been activated 2 times
